description: Get the latest market-wide news across all tickers, most recent first (not filtered to one company). Every item is significance-classified at ingest (critical | major | standard); the default filter of critical,major is the "top stories" view. Served by the /news/latest public endpoint (added 2026-07-29; 404 on a backend without it).

limit.description: Maximum items to return (1-50). Defaults to 10.

significance.description: CSV of levels to include, e.g. "critical,major" (default) or "critical,major,standard". Only critical, major and standard exist; any other value is rejected.

name: get_market_news
title: Get Market News (Top Stories)
